methods.M0: G3 B1 fixed threshold 0.5 descriptive reference; do not refit
methods.M1: Validation-only, day-specific FPR-constrained alarm threshold on 201 pre-fixed grid + reject-all sentinel; maximize validation attack TPR subject to DKW upper bound of benign alarm rate <=0.01; ties take largest threshold
methods.M2: Validation-only abstention band: alarm if p>=M1 high threshold; benign if p<=low chosen as largest grid threshold below high with DKW upper bound of attack falsely classified benign <=0.05; abstain otherwise
